name: Brightspeed
notes: Researched from public brightspeed.com help pages only (no sign-in). My Brightspeed signs in with a username and password; enrolling needs the account number and ZIP code and sometimes a security code Brightspeed sends (no dossier field for the code). Password resets need the username and account number. Quick Bill Pay takes one-time payments without signing in using the account number plus basic account details (modelled as account number + ZIP). One-time card payments (My Brightspeed, Quick Bill Pay, phone/chat) carry a $3.50 fee per payment; bank payments are free; AutoPay with any method is fee-free. AutoPay starts the following billing cycle and is processed 18 days after the bill date (the page contrasts bill date with due date); the date cannot be changed. Payment arrangements: two installments within 30 days, one payment within 30 days, or past-due only; not all accounts qualify. Late fees range from a flat $5 to a percentage, depending on service and location (not modelled). Cancellation is by phone at 833-692-7773, 8 am-6 pm Monday-Friday. Online future-dated one-time payments are not described (family default kept). Reviewer: the AutoPay page says any payment method including AutoPay is free, while the payment-arrangement page charges $3.50 per card payment; one-time card payments keep the $3.50 fee and AutoPay card charges are fee-free (autopayCardCents 0). The AutoPay page also says the draft is 18 days after the bill due date while defining the bill date as the issue date; the issue-date reading is kept. Integrated 2026-10-10: billing.autopay.daysAfterBill 18: AutoPay drafts 18 days after the bill date.

cancel_service.note: Brightspeed service is cancelled by phone: call 833-692-7773 (MYBRSPD), 8 am-6 pm Monday-Friday. A temporary hold is an alternative.

help.title: Ways to pay your Brightspeed bill
paragraphs: Pay online in My Brightspeed, or use Quick Bill Pay for a one-time payment without signing in; you need your account number and some basic account details, payments register the same day, and payment details are not saved.

Online and by phone you can pay from checking or savings, with a Visa, Mastercard or Discover credit card, a debit card, or in some areas a money market account. You can also mail a check or money order, or pay in person at partner locations, the only places that take cash.
A one-time card payment carries a $3.50 fee; paying from a bank account avoids it. AutoPay is free with any payment method.

help.title: Enroll in AutoPay
paragraphs: Sign in to My Brightspeed, choose Sign Up for AutoPay in Billing and Payments, then select Set Up AutoPay on Manage AutoPay and enter your details on AutoPay Details. A bank account is the default, but you can choose a Visa, Mastercard or Discover credit card or a debit card instead.

AutoPay begins with the next billing cycle, so keep paying until you get a confirmation. The payment is processed 18 days after your bill date, and that date cannot be changed. You can also enroll by mail with the enrollment form or the authorization on the back of your remittance slip.
steps: Enter your payment details and save.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: The Payment Plan Tool, reached with your account number or billing phone number and ZIP code, offers three choices: pay the total in two installments within 30 days, pay it in one payment within 30 days, or pay only the past-due amount by the date shown. You can also use the automated phone line or a specialist by phone or chat.
Not every account qualifies. Bank payments on a plan are free; each card payment costs $3.50. Late fees may still apply to payments dated after the due date.
steps: Pick one of the plan options.
Choose a bank account or card and confirm.

help.title: How late fees are calculated
paragraphs: Late fees depend on your services and location and range from a flat $5 fee to a percentage of the amount due, or both. To avoid them, your payment must arrive and be processed by the due date; mail checks 7 to 10 days early, or pay online, by the automated phone line, or with AutoPay.

help.title: Cancel your Brightspeed service
paragraphs: To cancel or close your account, call 833-692-7773 (MYBRSPD) between 8 am and 6 pm, Monday through Friday. If you are only away for a while, a temporary hold suspends service at a reduced rate and keeps your phone number.
Return any leased modem or router within 30 days of cancelling to avoid an equipment fee of up to $200.

help.title: Signing in to My Brightspeed
paragraphs: Sign in with the username and password you created when you enrolled. To enroll you need your account number and ZIP code, and you may be asked for a security code that Brightspeed sends you.
Forgot your username? Have it emailed to the address on file. To reset a password you need your username and account number.

extra.intent: You want to cancel Brightspeed home phone service. Using Brightspeed's help pages, find the phone number to call. Do not cancel anything online or make a payment.
Using Brightspeed's help pages, find the fee for making a one-time payment with a credit or debit card. Do not make a payment.
